scope: Synthetic add-to-cart events; not real purchases, a causal effect estimate, or a forecast. No live/demo database models are read or written.
protocol: Same guest/dish/outcome stream for all policies; fresh LinUCB per seed/scenario; only chosen-arm feedback used. Existing production context features and alpha, no tuning on these outcomes.

scenarios.title: У гостей разные предпочтения
scenarios.rule: P(add)=0.65 for the hidden preferred style, 0.15 otherwise. Hidden styles cycle across six guest profiles.

scenarios.title: Описание не влияет на реакцию
scenarios.rule: P(add)=0.30 for every guest and style. Paired outcome draws give identical outcomes for all policies.

scenarios.title: Всем нравится краткий вариант
scenarios.rule: P(add)=0.65 for concise, 0.15 otherwise, regardless of guest.
